name: What happens at a federal sentencing hearing?

mainEntity.name: What happens at a federal sentencing hearing?

acceptedAnswer.text: At a federal sentencing hearing, your attorney will argue for a fair sentence, presenting mitigating factors to minimize penalties and showing why harsh sentences are not warranted.federalcriminaldefense+1​
